authoritative_store: Private shared Kuina task hub, configured by AGENT_TASKS.md

review_batches.parent_jobs: retained as unassigned nonclaimable coordination records

assignment_requests.transport: GitHub issue created by participant using normal website link
assignment_requests.title: [Kuina claim] TASK_ID or [Kuina release] TASK_ID
assignment_requests.confirmation: Mac broker validates author and request, atomically reserves or releases in Native, and records result on issue; snapshot then reflects confirmed status
assignment_requests.release_generation: positive assignment_issue must match the current reservation origin

workflow: choose your identity and an available batch on the website
submit the prepared GitHub issue and wait for broker confirmation
list your assigned tasks; resume active work first
claim using your own Native agent process and stop if denied
read-batch for the exact private catalogue section
inspect existing data and metadata and reuse shared source findings
submit deduplicated repair scope across batches

claims.release_allowed: own reservation only before a real worker claim exists

publication: Only roster, aggregate counts, whitelisted task statuses and GitHub assignment requests are public. Catalogue scopes, targets, paths, reports and evidence remain private.
snapshot_roster_compatibility: Readers accept only the complete historical nine-person roster or the complete eleven-person roster. Every assigned participant and legacy category lead must be present in that snapshot. New snapshots include all eleven participants.
